name: Friday Night Funkin': Sprite Corruption
storyline:
It all starts off in a darkish red car, Our tiny protagonist (Boyfriend) and Scratch cat were having a rap battle in the car until Scratch Cat gets too distracted (He's the Driver) Scratch cat was too focused on the rap battle rather than the car, The car swerved, tires screeching with another. Then, out of nowhere, the sky glitched. A dark cloud loomed ahead, crackling with static. Blocking the road stood Kiran, once a friend, now twisted by corruption. Her eyes burned with an eerie glow, her movements jagged, unnatural.

Scratch Cat slammed the brakes, swerving hard, crashing into wrecked debris on the highway. Smoke curled from the wreck, but there was no time to worry about the car now. Grabbing the green flag, the only weapon he had, Scratch Cat stepped out the red car.
summary: Friday Night Funkin': Sprite Corruption is a fan-made Friday Night Funkin' mod that incorporates Scratchers and sprites from the Scratch library. The mod fuses original Scratch OCs and iconic characters like Scratch Cat into a corrupted, glitch-filled universe inspired by the 'Learning with Pibby' concept.
